summary: Linkhome Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K to report a Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Constant Investments, Inc. (dba Mortgage One Group) from its sole shareholders. Consideration is 300,000 restricted shares of Linkhome common stock, plus an earnout up to $750,000 cash (0.25% of funded loan volume over two years). Sellers also receive $250,000 in cash under consulting agreements over the same period, plus sign restrictive covenants. No price per share or premium is stated. The deal is structured as a private placement under Rule 506(b). Watch for closing conditions and post-acquisition integration.
